description: มุน 2026-08-03 (ฟีม, Figma 402:23220 · 626:4403 · 368:9807): the v2 top bar. ฟีม read three Figma headers and concluded 'left changes, right is always the same' — get_design_context confirms it, so the shared unit is THE RIGHT CLUSTER (upgrade? · bell 40 · avatar 40, gap 8, pinned right), not 'a header'. THREE bugs hid under 'the headers look different': (1) /v2/calendar rendered NO header at all — the ABSENCE class, which no 'is this header correct' check can ever catch because there is nothing to measure, so PRESENCE is its own invariant; (2) the cluster drifted per page in order/size/gap; (3) the อัพเกรด pill had three skins and could reach a PAID member — PILL-RULE is checked in BOTH directions (free must SHOW it) because a typo'd selector also returns 0. LAYOUT TRAP FOUND BY LOOKING, NOT BY DIFFING: dropping home's Structure A into AppHeader's `left` slot narrowed the column by the cluster's width and the element line silently wrapped to two lines — tsc was green throughout. Fix: export HeaderTools so home composes the cluster inside its own first row and keeps the full-width name (ฟีม 2026-07-26: a real name must never truncate). Also closes: home's pill was lime+navy+rounded-full vs Figma's grade-yellow+cyan+r8+cyan glow, and the calendar's 'mate' bell/avatar skins are retired per ฟีม's ruling that the look must be identical everywhere (kept in source, Rule 1).
